label: hitoiki
title: 一息
meaning: a short period of time 我慢することです
meaning_example: Don`t rest now work is almost finished.

notes.text:
 means [with one breath] and it is used to describe a short period of time, Usually in which something will accure. 





休憩しないで、後一息仕事が終わりますよ。



Don`t rest now, works almost finished.
